reader_summary.overview: We’re proud to release this week’s special episode, an interview with our wonderful guest, Chris Waller. Chris is the Founder and Portfolio Manager of Plural Investing. Before founding Plural, Chris worked in London at Goldman Sachs Asset Management.

key_points.text: Before founding Plural, Chris worked in London at Goldman Sachs Asset Management.
He has an MBA from the Value Investing program at Columbia Business School and completed his bachelor's degree at Oxford University.
Our conversation with Chris centered around the case for GCI Liberty.
